audience: podcasters who host their shows on Spreaker and want to check listener statistics and episode details

useCases.title: Rank episodes by plays and downloads
useCases.text: List your shows, then the episodes of one show. Read the plays and downloads of each episode between two dates.

useCases.title: Track plays over time
useCases.text: Read plays and downloads between two dates, grouped by day, week or month. Read the all-time totals of a show or an episode you own.

useCases.title: See where listeners come from
useCases.text: Read the listener sources, devices or operating systems for a show or an episode. Country data is available for shows only.

useCases.title: Read episode comments and chapters
useCases.text: Open an episode to read its counts and visibility. Then read the listener comments and the chapter list of that episode.

useCases.title: Edit an episode's title or description
useCases.text: Read an episode, then change its title, description, tags or visibility. Only the fields you send change. Setting visibility to public publishes the episode.
